description: The bar chart illustrates ratios (in percent) for three models—Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT—across three knowledge domains (Movies, Songs, Basketball). The horizontal axis contains the categories Movies, Songs, and Basketball in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “Ratio (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly 50 to 90+, with regularly spaced tick marks at 50, 60, 70, and 80 (and the bars extending close to 90). Each category shows a grouped set of three vertical bars: Llama3 is shown in blue, Qwen2 in red, and ChatGPT in yellow. For Movies, the blue Llama3 bar is just under 90% (about 89%), the red Qwen2 bar is about 90%, and the yellow ChatGPT bar is around 73%. For Songs, the blue Llama3 bar is in the mid-to-high 80s (about 84–85%), the red Qwen2 bar is about 89–90%, and the yellow ChatGPT bar is around 62–63%. For Basketball, the blue Llama3 bar is around 66–67%, the red Qwen2 bar is around 57–58%, and the yellow ChatGPT bar is around 61–62%. The bars are grouped by category with consistent color coding indicated by the legend at the top, there is no stacking, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis; the categories do not appear to be sorted by bar height.
